maya_cs: Heads-up: I put together a short customer note for tenants affected by today's onboarding ingestion stall. trying to keep it clear, mention next steps and how to get immediate help. pls review.

maya_cs: Hi <customer name>,

We wanted to let you know about a brief onboarding interruption that impacted document ingestion and indexing for some customers earlier today. Our engineers deployed a fix and we're running recovery jobs for all affected tenants.

Immediate actions we're taking:
• Kicking off tenant-specific reprocessing jobs (in progress)
• Running spot-check validations for sample documents per tenant
• Prioritizing any uploads that returned explicit errors in the last 12 hours

What you may see:
• Short delays in search results or embeddings for recently-uploaded data (most tenants will be caught up in ~2 hours; larger datasets may take longer)
• No data deletion or exposure has occurred

How we're helping you finish onboarding:
• If you'd like us to prioritize your tenant, reply with "PRIORITY_REINDEX" and we'll schedule a 1:1 enablement session within the next business day.
• We will issue a one-time credit for impacted onboarding windows; billing will reach out with details.

Want details on whether you were affected? Reply and we'll confirm your tenant status and surface any failed uploads.

Contact: support@redwood.ai or slack #support (business hours 9am-6pm PT).

We're sorry for the interruption and appreciate your patience.

—Maya, Customer Success (on behalf of Redwood Operations)
